records.title: A Step Back: Prefix Importance Ratio Stabilizes Policy Optimization
records.reason: arXiv abstract: MinPRO stabilizes off-policy LLM policy optimization during RL post-training; contribution is training stability/performance rather than inference compute or serving.

records.title: EvoClinician: A Self-Evolving Agent for Multi-Turn Medical Diagnosis via Test-Time Evolutionary Learning
records.reason: EvoClinician optimizes a clinical diagnose–grade–evolve loop. Its reported cost metric is a benchmark-specific sum of clinical question/test costs (normalized units), not model inference cost; the body reports resource-cost outcomes in the clinical decision environment. No model serving/inference efficiency change is established.

records.title: PathWise: Planning through World Model for Automated Heuristic Design via Self-Evolving LLMs
records.reason: PathWise uses LLMs and a world model to evolve search heuristics for automated algorithm design; its metrics concern heuristic performance/search optimization, not LLM inference cost or agent serving.

records.title: EMemBench: Interactive Benchmarking of Episodic Memory for VLM Agents
records.reason: EMemBench contributes an interactive benchmark for episodic-memory VLM agents and reports benchmark results; it does not introduce or validate an inference-efficiency optimization.

records.title: Computer Environments Elicit General Agentic Intelligence in LLMs
records.reason: This work studies computer environments as elicitors/evaluators of general agentic intelligence. It is an environment/evaluation contribution; no inference resource reduction is proposed.
